text:
Maya Patel: quick design QA — adding the 'Network prerequisites' step to private deploy flow. dropping a Figma link and screenshots. main concerns: copy clarity for firewall rules, ordering of checks, and a11y contrast for the status chips. ping if you can glance? https://www.figma.com/file/example
Alex Chen: :eyes: saw this. wording nit: 'Open ports' sounds scary to security teams. prefer 'Allow outbound and inbound traffic on ports X,Y' or 'Ensure these ports are reachable'.
Maya Patel: good point. current copy: 'Open the following ports on your firewall: 443, 2379, 2380'. suggestion: 'Ensure the following ports are reachable from your control plane and between nodes: 443 (HTTPS), 2379/2380 (etcd cluster).' shorter + explain why.
Jordan Lee: also propose reordering — run DNS + routing checks before port checks. if DNS fails people get confused by port errors. can we show a quick pass/fail with primary reason and a 'why this matters' tooltip?
Samir Rao: agree on order. add MTU/packet-size check for VPN setups (we've seen 1500 vs 9000 issues). also include a sample curl to test connectivity in the UI help.
Maya Patel: good call. what's a concise curl example we can show? maybe a single line users can paste.
Alex Chen: something like:
```
curl -vI https://<control-plane-ip>:443 --connect-timeout 5
```
or for etcd: 
```
curl -v http://<node-ip>:2379/v2/keys --connect-timeout 5
```
Keep it labeled as 'diagnostic only — opens a connection to verify reachability.'
Jordan Lee: accessibility: status chips (green/orange/red) have low contrast on dark mode. need contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small text. suggestion: use filled chips + white text, or add icons (check/x/warn) + visually hidden text for screen readers. also add aria-live region for preflight progress updates.
Maya Patel: noted. UX question: should the 'Run preflight checks' button be primary, and should we allow 'auto-fix' for some issues (e.g., suggest CIDR correction)?
Samir Rao: don't auto-change network rules. maybe offer 'suggested commands' users can copy. for some cloud providers we can show one-click guide links (AWS SG, GCP FW).
Alex Chen: copy tweak: 'Run preflight checks' -> 'Validate network & prerequisites' is more explicit. but keep button short; maybe primary label: 'Validate & Run' with tooltip 'checks connectivity, DNS, routing, and opens guidance.'
Maya Patel: love that. I'll try 'Validate & Run' with tooltip copy: 'Runs quick connectivity and configuration checks required for Private deployments.'
DeployBot: deployment preflight triggered by @Maya Patel — run-id 8c9a. status: queued.
Jordan Lee: micro copy: 'Why this matters' tooltip should be 1 sentence + link to documentation. avoid long legalese.
Maya Patel: action items: 1) change copy to 'Ensure the following ports are reachable...' 2) reorder checks: DNS -> Routing -> MTU -> Ports -> Service checks 3) add curl examples and cloud provider quick links 4) fix chip contrast and add icons + aria-live 5) update button to 'Validate & Run' with tooltip. I'll update the figma and ping design review. thanks :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: (followup) will draft the docs snippet for curl and provider links and drop it into the PR. will also add the sample iptables commands for self-hosted firewalls: 
```
# allow https and etcd
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 2379 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 2380 -j ACCEPT
```
Samir Rao: perfect — can you also add a note about limiting to control-plane CIDRs and not 0.0.0.0/0? we've had customers accidentally wide-open ports.
Maya Patel: yup, will add 'restrict source CIDR to your control plane / nodes where possible — avoid 0.0.0.0/0.'
